description: This file implements the PlayerComponents class and its factory methods for creating audio and video renderer components, including stub decoders, within the starboard media player filter module.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsImpl
classes.description: Implementation of PlayerComponents that provides access to media time, audio, and video renderers.

classes.name: MonotonicSystemTimeProviderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a monotonic system time provider returning current monotonic time.

classes.name: PlayerComponents::Factory::CreationParameters
classes.description: Holds parameters for creating player components, including stream info, player handle, output mode, and DRM system.

methods.name: CreateComponents
methods.description: Creates and configures audio and video decoders, renderers, and media time providers based on creation parameters and command line switches.

methods.name: CreateStubAudioComponents
methods.description: Creates stub audio decoder and sink components for testing or fallback.

methods.name: CreateStubVideoComponents
methods.description: Creates stub video decoder, render algorithm, and sink components for testing or fallback.

methods.name: GetAudioRendererParams
methods.description: Calculates and outputs parameters for audio renderer buffer sizes based on stream info and supported sample types.
